question: How long does a player have to show up in the lobby before the match is lost?
answer: A grace period of eight minutes (Article 6.8).

question: What is the annual fee for an Elite Division licence?
answer: 45,000 credits (Article 8.1).

question: How much money must an Elite Division club keep in its Financial Reserve?
answer: Not less than 120,000 credits (Article 9.1).

question: Can the same player be signed by two different clubs at the same time?
answer: No. A player may be registered to only one club at any time (Article 13.3).

question: What is the minimum monthly salary in the Open Division?
answer: 900 credits (Article 16.5).

question: When does the Secondary Transfer Window open and close?
answer: It opens on 27 December and closes on 14 January (Article 17.2).

question: How many players can a club buy during one transfer window?
answer: Not more than four (Article 18.4).

question: What happens if injuries leave a team with fewer players than the rules require?
answer: The roster must be restored within 28 days, otherwise fixtures are forfeit (Articles 14.6 and 14.7).

question: What is the highest number of points a club can take from a single fixture?
answer: Four: three for the win plus one bonus point for winning both Legs (Article 26.4).

question: What score is recorded when a club forfeits an entire fixture?
answer: A 6-0 aggregate defeat (Article 30.2).

question: If two clubs finish the season on the same number of points, how is the tie broken?
answer: By goal difference, then goals scored, then head-to-head, then fixtures won outright, then disciplinary points (Article 31).

question: Where will the 2026-27 championship final be played?
answer: On LAN at the Arena Marítima, Valmora (Article 32.5).

question: What happens when a player loses connection early in a leg?
answer: Before the fifteenth in-game minute the Leg is restarted in full with the score reset (Article 38.1).

question: What is the maximum latency allowed when playing a fixture remotely?
answer: 35 milliseconds to the designated server region (Article 41.2).

question: Am I allowed to use a wireless mouse during a match?
answer: No. Wireless connection of any component of the playing setup is prohibited (Article 41.7).

question: How long before the final can the game version no longer be changed?
answer: A Patch Freeze operates in the fourteen days preceding the Final (Article 43.4).

question: What is the minimum punishment for fixing a match?
answer: A five-year ban from all CEFA activity (Article 45.3).

question: Can a player bet on a match in the division he does not play in?
answer: No. The prohibition applies irrespective of the club or division concerned (Article 46.2).

question: How much is the fine for a false statement on the Matchsheet?
answer: 12,000 credits and forfeiture of the Fixture (Appendix C.1).

question: How much prize money does the champion of the Championship Playoffs receive?
answer: 760,000 credits (Appendix A.2).

question: Who scored the most goals in a single Elite Division regular season?
answer: Nahuel Ferrada of Puerto Halcón, with 61 goals in Season 2022-23 (B.4.3).

question: Which club plays at the highest venue above sea level?
answer: Monte Azur, at the Sala Altura, 2,840 metres above sea level (D.5).

question: Who is the head coach that has been in the job the longest?
answer: Verónica Castell of Sierra Bravo, appointed in 2021 (D.8).

question: Which build of the game is used for the opening match window of the season?
answer: Version 26.2.1 (Article 42.2 and E.6).

question: What did version 26.1.0 change?
answer: Corner kick accuracy reduced by six per cent, defensive line height adjustable during play, fatigue recovery standardised, two Tactical Presets exploits closed (E.4).

question: How much does it cost to file a protest against the conduct of a fixture?
answer: A deposit of 1,000 credits, refunded if the protest succeeds (Article 53.4).

question: How quickly must the Appeals Panel rule when the make-up of a competition is at stake?
answer: Within four days (Article 54.6).

question: How many hours of coaching is an academy player entitled to each week?
answer: A minimum of six hours of structured coaching per week (Article 66.1).

question: Where does the money collected from fines end up?
answer: In the Academy Development Fund (Articles 63.5 and 67.2).

question: What does Article 24 deal with?
answer: The registration embargo: its effect, grounds and duration.

question: Which article governs timeouts in knockout competition?
answer: Article 39 (39.4 to 39.7).

question: On what date does the Elite Division regular season actually end?
answer: Round 30 opens on 24 April 2027; Article 4.6 says 28 March 2027 but Appendix G.3.2 reads that as the end of Round 26 and G.3.3 makes the appendix prevail.
